def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    # Extract parameters from inputs
    x = inputs.get('initial_value', 283)
    rounds = inputs.get('rounds', 9)
    multiplier = inputs.get('multiplier', 800)
    increment = inputs.get('increment', 2900)
    modulus = inputs.get('modulus', 33500)
    
    # Apply the recurrence relation for the specified number of rounds
    for _ in range(rounds):
        x = (multiplier * x + increment) % modulus
    
    return float(x)
